PTN-01: portal ops ADMIN session (Debug tab, Show secret, partner CRUD)
PTN-02: POMA ops ADMIN session (conflict-checker Partner publish)

relations.ST_DAY: a seed presence day (111/112/113) of PH1, >= R+2, inside the seeded roster window
relations.SR_DAY: >= R+3, PH4 has no planning on it
relations.CM_DAY: a future day of the CURRENT month, >= R+2, PH5 free (run PTN-09 after a month change if the month ends within 2 days)
relations.NM_DAY: a weekday of the NEXT month, PH5 free, no Sollplan saved for that month
relations.RRX_DAY: >= R+3, ERX painted presence (seed P-PTN-9b), PH5 free
relations.XD1..XD8: eight consecutive weekdays >= R+7 and after the seeded roster end (outside the booking lead time PT48H)
relations.XD7N: the calendar day after XD7 (may equal XD8: another external HP)
relations.LEAD_DAY: R + 1 (inside the 48 h booking lead time)

exceptions.LEAD_DAY: intentionally inside the booking lead time (PTN-14 step 4)

PLACEHOLDERS.PARTNER_ID: id of the steward's run partner e2e-ptn-<run> (stage/run-partner doc); read-only for every worker
PLACEHOLDERS.GLN: the run GLN the steward wrote for DM-X today (stage/gln; 13 digits, run-unique, never the simulator default 7601001996908)

FOREIGN_GLN.doc: a 13-digit test GLN that no CT tenant carries (PTN-17 negative row)

PLACEHOLDERS.PROVIDER_CODE: provider code of the stage partner-simulator provider (gate P-PTN-3, stage/provider-gate), e.g. EWPS
PLACEHOLDERS.RUN_TAG: 8 lowercase letters / digits for run-unique names: throw-away partners e2e-ptn-x|l|g-<tag>, external HPs 'E2E PTN <tag> A|B|C' with e-mails e2e-ptn-<tag>-a|b|c@zinc.ch, pools e2e-ptn-<tag>-a|b
PLACEHOLDERS.PH_NODE: Gruppe node of Notfallzentrum on DM-X (PH1..PH5): KNOTEN_ID and name
PLACEHOLDERS.SPX_NODE: Planblatt (Gruppe) node of Intensivpflege on DM-X used as BADI group-node-id by SPX: KNOTEN_ID
PLACEHOLDERS.PORTAL_PROFILE: absolute path of the runner's PolyPortal ops browser profile (ADMIN; outside results/)
PLACEHOLDERS.POMA_OPS_PROFILE: absolute path of the runner's POMA ops browser profile (ADMIN; outside results/; conflict-checker 'Partner' publish)
